title: Fish-Feeder Confirmation and Overfeeding Guard
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), vivarium climate (`vivarium:climate`), fish feeder (`fishfeeder:event`), auto-doser (`doser:event`), auto-top-off (`ato:event`), pond sensors (`pondsensor:reading`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium controllers — reef-tank parameter monitors, auto-dosers, auto-top-off, reptile terrarium climate/UVB, and pond sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and controller APIs (e.g. Apex, GHL, ESPHome).
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishfeeder:event
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as feeds by _time
| eval status=case(feeds=0,"missed",feeds>3,"overfed",1=1,"ok")
| sort - _time
description: Confirms the automatic feeder ran the right number of times, catching both a missed meal and accidental overfeeding.
value: A jammed feeder starves fish while a double-trigger fouls the water; a simple daily count keeps feeding just right.
implementation: Ingest feeder events into `index=personal`; schedule daily and flag missed or excessive feeds.
visualization: Column chart of daily feeds with a normal range.
grandmaExplanation: It checks the automatic fish feeder ran the right number of times, so the fish are neither missed nor overfed.
